fullDescription: Primary profile-photo capture view for member verification. It presents the branded top navigation, a camera selector, a large live-preview placeholder, a capture guidance panel, and footer actions for returning home, canceling, taking, and confirming a compliant member photo using the shared capture component.

Composable membership landing component that assembles the branded top bar, large action tiles, centered membership search section, and reusable empty-state callout for unmatched customer searches. It supports related membership entry flows by reusing shared input and button primitives inside a consistent branded shell.

Structured membership form component for attaching a secondary member to a primary account. It includes the branded header, step rail, personal identity fields, contact verification rows, address checkboxes, and bottom action groups, and is composed from shared button, input, select, and checkbox primitives so other membership views can reuse the same form sections or shell.

Compact verification dialog for confirming multiple member contacts in one flow. It supports verified and pending rows, avatar presentation, warning and success status states, grouped four-digit code inputs, resend actions, and a primary completion button so other membership flows can reuse the same confirmation pattern.

Profile-photo capture component that renders the branded application header, camera selection control, neutral preview stage, instructional compliance card, and bottom action bar for navigation, canceling, capturing, and confirming a saved image. It reuses the shared button and select primitives and can support additional photo-capture states in other member flows.
